user_reviews.Name: Mireya Salinas
user_reviews.Description:
I rarely write reviews, but the team at Rodriguez Tire Shop truly saved the day—or rather, the early morning! I had just retrieved my stolen vehicle from the impound lot around 1:00 AM when I discovered I had a flat tire that desperately needed patching. I was stressed, exhausted, and certain I wouldn't find anyone open at that hour.
​Thankfully, Rodriguez Tire Shop was there. Not only were they open, but they fixed the tire quickly and efficiently. What impressed me most was their dedication; they even managed to expertly work around the issue of the missing wheel lock without any fuss.
​Considering the specialized, late-night service, their rates were incredibly affordable. If you're ever in a bind, day or night, I cannot recommend this shop highly enough. They provide amazing service and real peace of mind when you need it most.

user_reviews.Name: Brandon Walters
user_reviews.Description:
5/26 Review Update: I've been referred to a separate company that Discount Tires uses for claims. Have not made any significant progress whatsoever. Beyond frustrating how long this is already taking. Will be waiting on Discount Tire to take responsibility. If this happens to you, I'd recommend filing a police report at the Discount Tire location. I'll be hiring an attorney if this takes much longer.

Original Review: I brought my white Mercedes SUV in to Discount Tire for what should have been a simple single tire replacement. When I picked the vehicle up, the rear left quarter panel had significant damage that was clearly not there beforehand. It appears the vehicle was either backed into something black or hit by a black car while in their possession.

Rather than taking accountability, the store attempted to deflect blame and also told me they do not have cameras in the parking lot. I’m now being forced to go through an insurance claim process with their regional office and still have not been contacted with any update.

What should have been a quick and routine service appointment has turned into an extremely frustrating experience. I take great care of my vehicle, and now I’m stuck driving around with major damage and no clear resolution timeline. I’ll continue updating this review as the process progresses.

user_reviews.Name: Brandon McGee
user_reviews.Description:
I would have given them 1 star but I have had many tires patched in the past properly, this time I had tires pulled off my wheel and mounted on new ones and balanced. When I called I told the guy what I wanted and he quoted me $120. Upon arrival I was told $160 because of the sensors, I told them I just wanted normal valve stems and the guy helping me called over the older man they called maestro. He said $140. While they were talking, I grabbed some valve stems from a repair kit and he still wanted to charge me $140.

Then, I had forgotten I needed new acorn style lugs but the thin profile for my new wheels. I went to get the lugs quickly and returned and was told they were too thin. He then gave me a different acorn that was thicker and sent me back for new lugs. Against my better judgement I grabbed new ones and then they ok’ed them. When it came time to put the lugs on, they realized the keyed socket wouldn’t fit and maestro tried to tell me that the old ones were the proper lugs. When installing the guy let the impact just crack them down. I knew immediately it was incorrect and ordered the proper lugs from the wheel manufacturer. When I changed them out I noticed my brand new wheels were scratched badly inside. The new lugs were the exact ones I brought to them originally.

Won’t be returning for any repairs or anything now. I’ll pay the extra cash for Discount tire.

user_reviews.Name: gebrin alvarez
user_reviews.Description:
I recently drove to this shop to have my tire checked because I had noticed a screw in it. Unfortunately, my experience left me questioning both the quality of the work and the honesty of the service.

When I arrived, the employee pointed out the screw, but instead of removing it first to confirm whether it had actually punctured through, he immediately began working to put the tire back on the rim. Only after that did he submerge the tire in the water tank—something that should have been done first to properly identify any leaks.

After leaving the shop, while driving with the window down, I heard a repetitive noise from the tire — a clear sign that something was still lodged in it. I pulled over and found the same screw still in place, the very reason I had come in. What’s more concerning is that even if there had been more than one screw or nail, the employee never bothered to pull them all out and verify they were properly handled. That shows a lack of thoroughness and doesn’t build trust with customers.

In addition, the employee who handled my service (the one wearing sunglasses) did not seem very careful when lifting my vehicle, as he didn’t check for the proper lift points. His overall approach felt rushed and inattentive.

While the repair only cost $15, customers deserve honesty and proper service no matter the price. My advice to future visitors is to be cautious, double-check the work before leaving, and if you deal with the employee wearing sunglasses, make sure his work is reviewed. When customers pay for service, they should leave confident and satisfied, not worried.

user_reviews.Name: Lexus Tatge
user_reviews.Description: I was driving my 1998 jeep wrangler for the first time in 3 weeks when 10 mins into my drive 45 minute drive I heard a loud squeak and then smelled smoke. I pulled over into a random parking lot, opened my hood, and saw that my belt had snapped in half. I called a tow truck but the ETA was for 4:36pm and it was 3:00pm (Saturday of the Texas/OU game). It’s was 90° out and I had no water so I started walking to the nearest gas station and within 0.1 miles I stumbled upon this body shop. I walked up to the door on a whim and asked if they could fix an engine belt. Within 30 seconds they’re walking with me back to my car in a completely different parking lot, checking it out. It turns out it wasn’t just a serpentine belt but a pulley as well. Long story short - they fixed everything by 4:45 (only 9 minutes after the tow was supposed to show up). This was so last minute and they sprang to the rescue. If I still lived in Dallas this would be my go-to place. I’m grateful for the service and I highly recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Jarrod Wright
user_reviews.Description:
Dallas Collision Center managed the repair of our 2025 Audi RS 6 Avant Performance over the last few months. Everybody was outstanding. We could not have asked for a better experience.

John Love oversaw everything from start to finish. He was professional, utterly competent, communicative, friendly and customer-focused. He went above and beyond what I would have expected in many ways. For example, he always responded to emails or calls within one business day, in most cases the same day. He kept in constant communication as he worked with our insurance company to get repairs approved and parts ordered, the vast majority of them specialized bits from Germany that weren't stocked in the U.S.

He saved us a substantial amount of money by working with the artists (that's the right word, no doubt about it) doing the repairs and paintwork to avoid removing and re-applying the paint protection film on the hood. He also kindly coordinated with the local XPEL shop to arrange for them to come out and reapply PPF when the car was done. And at my request, when everything was finished he took the car out for a thorough test drive to ensure there were no squeaks, rattles, groans or moans. There were none. The car was delivered perfectly.

We picked the vehicle up a couple days ago. We could not be happier with the quality of the work. The paint was blended and matched perfectly, and the finish is smooth and glossy with no orange peel. And the panel gaps and fitment are as good or better -- mostly better -- than they were from the factory.

We cannot recommend Dallas Collision Center and John Love enough. They made an expensive and time-consuming situation as pleasant as it could possibly have been. Do not hesitate to bring your vehicle to them.

I recently purchased a Tesla, and just two weeks later, I was rear-ended. Without hesitation, I turned to Texas Collision Center-Lovefield, and I couldn’t be more impressed with their service. From the moment I arrived, Destiney walked me through every step of the process, explaining how everything would work with the insurance company. She went above and beyond, ensuring that all communications with the insurance provider were handled smoothly and keeping me informed at every stage.

Destiney provided timely updates on the status of the insurance approval, the arrival of parts, and the repair process itself. Any time I had a concern, she was quick to respond, offering reassurance and clarity. When I dropped off my car, they even arranged for Enterprise to pick me up, making the entire experience seamless.

The turnaround time was incredibly fast—Texas Collision Center had my Tesla fully restored in just seven days. The repairs were absolutely flawless, as if the accident had never happened. I truly hope I won’t need collision repairs in the future, but if I ever do, this will be the only shop I trust.

The entire staff is knowledgeable, helpful, and professional. If you’re looking for a collision repair shop that delivers top-tier service and craftsmanship, I highly recommend Texas Collision Center-Lovefield!

user_reviews.Name: AFAQ MOTIWALA
user_reviews.Description:
I recently took my Mercedes-Benz GLS to Elite Auto on Harry Hines, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Since it’s a European vehicle, I was honestly very nervous about where to take it — but these guys completely exceeded my expectations.

They are extremely professional and clearly have strong experience working on European cars. The quality of their work and customer service is better than many big-name shops I’ve dealt with in the past. What really stood out to me was their honesty. Multiple other body shops insisted that my lift gate needed to be replaced, which would have been very expensive. Elite Auto, on the other hand, took the time to actually assess the damage and recommended repairing it instead — saving me a significant amount of money.

The repair work itself was outstanding. The dent was fixed perfectly, and the car looks fantastic. No shortcuts, no pressure, just honest advice and excellent craftsmanship.

It’s hard to find a shop you can truly trust, especially for luxury or European vehicles, but Elite Auto has earned mine. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality, integrity, and top-tier service.

user_reviews.Name: Juno
user_reviews.Description:
Professional, Efficient, and Fair – Better than the Dealership!

I recently had running boards installed on my Acura MDX at Elite Auto Body Shop, and the experience was flawless from start to finish.

After receiving a quote from the dealership, I was shocked by their pricing—they are truly out of their mind with those estimates. Following a high recommendation from a co-worker who had great results with their body work here, I decided to give Elite a try. It was the right decision.

Key Highlights:
• Speed: The entire process took less than 3 hours.
• Service: Kuba, the operator, is incredibly friendly and focuses on building genuine customer connections. It’s rare to find that level of thoughtfulness.
• Value: Unlike the dealership, Kuba provided a very fair price and did not overcharge.

If you want smooth, honest service and professional installation without the "dealership tax," I highly recommend Elite Auto Body Shop. I highly recommend their service over any dealership alternative.

user_reviews.Name: Matt Barron
user_reviews.Description:
I brought my Lexus to Harvey’s (Maple location) for a bumper repair. When I got the car back, the paint was not blended on the left fender and the repair wasn’t molded correctly. There was also visible debris in the paint. Staff acknowledged it should have been caught, and I offered to pay for a new fender if needed.

They attempted to fix it, but the car was returned with additional issues, including a chipped fender, misaligned bumper, smudged door handle, and a chip on the hood down to the primer. Communication throughout the process was inconsistent, and I often had to follow up for updates.

Later, I worked with another location where communication initially improved and additional repairs were attempted. However, the paint still did not match, and plans that were discussed to correct the color mismatch were ultimately changed without explanation. The final solution offered did not resolve the issue, and I was told to pick up the vehicle.

In the end, the car was left in worse condition than when I originally brought it in. While the experience started positively, follow-through and consistency declined, and commitments that were discussed were not honored. Based on my experience, I would not return.

user_reviews.Name: Eduardo Rios Olivas
user_reviews.Description:
Please stay away from this Bodyshop. They did such a horrible and poor job with my car that I had to return my car to them a total of 3 times and they kept my car an extra 3 weeks after "fixin" my car and my car was never properly fixed. They do not have the knowledge when it comes to working on new cars. I have a 2025 Honda accord that was in an accident and it was sent to them for repairs. They are unaware of new cars technology and parts necessary when it comes to fixing new cars. They had my car for a month and I had to return the car back to them SEVERAL times because I kept having issues AFTER they "fixed" my car. First my car died on me a day after first getting it back from them, they thought it was the battery, they replaced the battery. They said it was probably the car had been sitting in their shop for a month. I get the car back, go to work, it is new years eve, my car is dead, AGAIN! called them and they can't seem understand why my car keeps dying. They finally figured out they actually bought a wrong headlight and that the headlight was draining my battery life (it is a hybrid model). I get my car back after they had my car for over a week in total, a drive the car and 2 days later, I start hearing really weird and loud noises coming from the front of the car. I called them, they take my car back and after they inspect the car again, it turned out the right front axle shaft was leaking grease (they fixed that part because that was where I got hit). They have my car for another week. I end up getting my car back and LITERALLY 1 day after , I hear the same noises from the week before AGAIN! At this point, I am fed up and I know it will be a never ending nightmare with this bodyshop. They should have fixed my car properly from the very beginning but their lack of knowledge and shoddy work made me take my car to the Honda dealership where it is getting fixed PROPERLY and with the CORRECT body part.
So please, stay away from this shop. They do not know what they are doing and you will be having issue after issue with them.

user_reviews.Name: Marcus Dumas
user_reviews.Description:
My car's driver-side window was destroyed during a break-in just before Thanksgiving. I chose this shop because it is one of State Farm's preferred locations. My initial impressions were mixed after the assessment, as the professional suggested my convertible top would need to be replaced, even though it was only the glass that was damaged. After further evaluation and repairs elsewhere, it became clear that the convertible top was in fine condition, and the issue was resolved without replacing it. This raised questions about whether the shop was being overly cautious or potentially upselling repairs.

That said, my car remained at this shop for 34 days due to insurance negotiations and holiday scheduling delays. Although my vehicle was ultimately not repaired here, I genuinely appreciated the excellent customer service. Ruth at the front desk was exceptionally kind and accommodating, and Andrew went above and beyond by agreeing to wash my car, even though no repairs were completed.

The communication from the staff was warm, clear, and consistent throughout the process. Despite my initial skepticism regarding the convertible top assessment, the overall experience was positive, and I experienced no hassle or disruptions from the shop. Thank you, Texas Collision Centers on Reeder Road (Ruth and Andrew!!! 🙌🏾), for your professionalism and customer service.

user_reviews.Description: Going .5 mph, I had a little run-in with a concrete stanchion!! My Tahoe’s front bumper & light assembly were badly damaged!! My daughter-in-law recommended Saleem & Service Excellence Collision Repair Center. My son had been there twice in the past after being hit by reckless drivers & sustaining major damage to his cars!! Saleem shopped for parts & provided me with an estimate for repairs that was $1000 less than another collision center & $3300 less than the auto dealership!! Today, four business days after I left my Tahoe with Saleem & his crew, my ride was ready!! When my daughter-in-law & I arrived at Service Excellence, we both gasped!! There in front of the building was a beautiful silver Tahoe, my Tahoe!! To make the necessary repairs, the whole front end of my SUV had to be removed!! The entire light assembly was replaced & I actually had a working front right turn signal. The bumper had been realigned, cleaned up, sanded & painted. The dent had been removed from the hood & it was painted!! I know it took so much more to complete this job than what I am describing & these are only  the major items that I remember!! Not only was the paint & body work completed exceptionally well; but Saleem was the consummate professional, staying in touch with us on a daily basis, being honest & forthcoming!! I definitely recommend Service Excellence to anyone needing auto paint & body repair, including my friends & family members!!

user_reviews.Description:
I had an outstanding experience with Service Excellence Collision Repair Center. I came in needing a tail light replacement, and they exceeded my expectations in every way. Not only was the price very reasonable, but the quality of the work was top-notch—you’d never know there had been any damage at all.

What really stood out was the customer service. The staff was friendly, professional, and took the time to explain everything clearly. They made the entire process quick and stress-free, and I felt confident my vehicle was in good hands from start to finish.

It’s not always easy to find a shop that combines affordability, quality work, and excellent customer care, but this place delivers on all three. I highly recommend them to anyone needing collision repairs—you won’t be disappointed.

I had a great experience with Ramirez Auto Body Shop on Fitzhugh in East Dallas. One of our plumbing vans had roof damage, and from the very first phone call their team was locked in. They picked up right away, were extremely responsive, and let me know I could bring the van in immediately.

The repair was completed within just a couple of days, which honestly exceeded my expectations.

Throughout the process, they stayed in communication, checked in, and provided updates so there were no surprises. The workmanship was excellent, the pricing was very fair, and the overall professionalism was top tier.

If you’re looking for an auto body shop that values communication, respects your time, and delivers high-quality work, Ramirez Auto Body Shop is an easy recommendation. Five stars without hesitation.

user_reviews.Name: Neva Cochran
user_reviews.Description: Excalibur Collision is second-to-none in collision repairs. I was so fortunate to be referred to them when I had extensive damage to the front end of my car in 2024, when it rolled into a farm gate post going less than 5 MPH. My luxury car dealer's collision center's repair estimate was $13,000, and said it could be as much as $18,000 once they started the repairs! When I went to Excalibur, they could do it for just over $3000. Why? Because they repair instead of replacing parts, if possible. Nick Salmeron, the manager, even called to find out if the car manufacturer would sell a headlight assembly without the headlight, which was not damaged. And they would! That was a definite cost savings. Nick is incredibly personable as well as knowledgeable and efficient. The owner, Alex Gonzalez, is also very nice and even fixed a door seal issue I had after another repair and once offered to take me home when I came to pick up my car in an Uber before it was ready. But they quickly finished up on my car, so I just waited. This locally-owned business is so customer-service oriented. Unfortunately, I have had two more small incidents with my car since then, going less than 5 MPH with no other vehicles involved and both times Excalibur has come through for me superbly!

user_reviews.Name: Krishna Desai
user_reviews.Description:
Highly recommend; this is the quintessential trustworthy family business mechanic. Great customer service, good price.

I came to Mayo’s to get hail damage repaired. The owner’s son, Mayo, took my call directly. I did not work through insurance.

When we met in person, Mayo first assessed whether PDR was doable to fix the dents or full panels would need to be removed. At other shops, they went straight to the PDR quote. Afterwards, he gave me options on how to quote the work I wanted done, including extent of repairs. I did not feel he was upselling me at any point. I ended up bundling other minor restoration work with my hail claim, receiving a discount.

The repairs took 3 days (which is the expectation Mayo set) and, at face value, appear to be high quality. I would go here again.

The best part of working with Mayo is his communication is on-point and direct 2 consumer… I never had to route through 5 layers of admin.

user_reviews.Description:
I’ve had a really great experience with Caliber Collision overall at two different locations. One was the Dallas location at 3201 Manor Way with Paige McQueen, and the other was the Allen location at 29 Prestige Circle with Charles Jones. Both experiences were smooth, professional, and exceeded my expectations.

Paige was amazing throughout the entire process. She was very straightforward, communicative, and kept me updated every step of the way, which made everything so much less stressful. The whole process moved way quicker than I expected, and my car was actually ready before the estimated completion date.

Charles was also great to work with and provided excellent customer service and communication throughout my experience at the Allen location. He even took the time to try to smooth out my license plate that had obvious damage from the front bumper accident, which I really appreciated because it showed he genuinely cared about the little details too.

One of the reasons I originally chose Caliber Collision was because of all the positive reviews I saw online, and they definitely did not disappoint. After having such positive experiences at two separate locations, I can confidently say their reputation is well deserved. Highly recommend Paige McQueen, Charles Jones, and the Caliber Collision team as a whole!

user_reviews.Name: JRM
user_reviews.Description:
$1,500 estimate to replace a non-existent part
…
Gave an estimate of around $1,500 to replace a non-existent part.
Didn't fix the problem at all.
Unnecessary diagnosis fees.
…
A) Provided the shop with a clear description of the vehicle's issue (air coming into the fuel line on top of the fuel filter) in person and in writing.
B) Was charged about $300 for a diagnosis fee for an unsolicited, unnecessary, and completely erroneous diagnosis.
C) Given an estimate of about $1,500 to replace a non-existent part (fuel pump in the tank). Doubled down in the shop about the misdiagnosis. They backed down only when they couldn't show me where the part was in the vehicle. The Service Manual shows the fuel pump is on the engine block, and not in the tank.
D) Issue (air leak into fuel line) remained after four visits to Southwest Auto. "Will go away" was their take.
E) Contacted the shop via email and phone (including one of the owners) six times. The service manager "is no longer with the shop." Didn't offer to fix the original issue, but to bring the vehicle back to repeat the high-fee diagnosis and estimate process.
…
Dealership's estimate to replace the fuel filter is LESS than SWA's diagnosis charges. Mercedes-Benz: "For the replacement of the fuel filter, the cost would be $290.14. This total is including labor, parts, taxes and fees."
…
The staff at SWA is friendly, but they constantly mention possible catastrophic issues (bad injectors, bad high-pressure fuel pump, etc.) to prepare customers for more 'reasonable' but still high charges.

user_reviews.Description: In the past I had taken my 2016 Volvo s60 to Park Place for service. I have had good (expensive) service there, but decided to look elsewhere since my car is no longer under an extended warranty. I went to their yelp page and looked at the negative reviews to find out where people in Dallas were taking their Volvo’s instead. There were several recommendations for Southwest Auto. I needed an oil change but also had coolant leaking. It was so easy to get an immediate appointment on their website. When I arrived the next day, Corey was there to greet me and set me up with a complimentary loaner for the day. He texted and emailed me very quickly with a detailed report on what my car needed. Once I agreed the work was done very quickly. The price was way less than the dealer and is guaranteed for 3 years. One thing the dealership always tried to scare/sell me with is the work wasn’t guaranteed if you go somewhere else. As a woman, it meant a lot to me that I felt no pressure or like I was being ripped off. It felt like a completely trustworthy experience. I will be taking my car here for the rest of its life.

user_reviews.Name: Joanne Combs
user_reviews.Description:
I can’t say enough about Chris and his entire team. Their honesty and integrity truly stood out during what could have been a very stressful situation.
We brought our Land Rover in for a second opinion after my daughter had taken her vehicle to the Land Rover dealership for a routine oil change. She was charged $450 for a high-grade oil change (which already felt excessive, as I typically pay around $250 in Connecticut), and then presented with a list of recommended repairs totaling over $5,000. What was most concerning is that there were no issues with the car prior to the visit. They claimed she needed a new battery, hoses, and several other items. It honestly felt like my daughter was being taken advantage of.
I immediately researched reputable shops in the area and came across Chris. From the very first interaction, he was attentive, professional, and genuinely caring. He had my daughter bring the car in for a diagnostic and provided an honest, thorough quote. Come to find out, her car did not need any of the items the dealership had recommended.
Thank you, Chris, and thank you to your entire team for your transparency, professionalism, and most importantly, your honesty. It’s rare to find a business you can truly trust, and we are incredibly grateful to have found yours.
Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: SWyatt
user_reviews.Description:
I brought my car in for a tune up. Upon picking up my vehicle I noticed my computer (dashboard) had been reset - which is common since batteries are generally disconnected during the service. I later noticed the power windows on both the front driver and passenger side were malfunctioning (short choppy movements). Eventually the driver side resolved but the passenger side did not. I had just spent over $700 in service. Their initial quote for repair was $400. After I voiced my frustration, they then offered to cover the cost but would need to confirm with the mechanic (I have no idea why the business owner and mechanics operate independently). After a few hours of no communication I called and they walked back their offer and said they would split the cost. I declined since the damaged happened on their watch. They initially denied having removed the battery and further stated their work would have no impact on the power windows - basic research determines this to be false.

There should be never be a scenario where a vehicle returns from a mechanic in lesser shape than what was delivered. Couple that with the poor response from the proprietor once this issue was brought to their attention and you have an experience that does not warrant a return visit. I had been going to Highlands Auto Center for years but the most recent visit forced me to conclude my dealings with them.

Side note: I looked back at these positive reviews and am now calling into question their authenticity. Truly ask yourself if people leave reviews like this when it comes to auto work.

user_reviews.Description:
I had Richard look at my old car when I first moved to dallas in 2018. He diagnosed the issue quickly and for cheap. It turned out to be an issue that wasn't worth the money to fix, as so many things on the car were broken and the car had 100k miles on it I believe.

I have my car with him now, and when I told him the issue and what had been done at another shop, he verified what I thought it was quickly, super friendly when I dropped it off, and answers the  phone when you call. It's a small shop with what seems like an unusually large number of parking spots, so it looks they are working on a bunch of cars at any given time. In a fairly decent area, right off of Ross Ave near a bunch of businesses, many open late...not sure what security they have in the lot (if they do at all), but the second time I dropped it off at night, had it towed from the highway, I noticed the lot is brightly lit even at 10pm or so when I was there. Seems like a safe place for your car to be overall.

His estimate was less than what insurance thought it should be, and far less than what a couple other shops in the area wanted to charge for the fix.

Super easy to work with, friendly, jovial in person, and seems to know his stuff. I will, likely, take my car here for any future issues/repairs it might need.

user_reviews.Name: Mario Gomez
user_reviews.Description:
I broke down across from this shop because my serpentine belt came out. Javier diagnosed the tensioner belt was bad. After 3 hours they finished and it cost me in total for labor and parts $533.45. I asked other mechanics how long it takes to replaced it and they told me an experience mechanic will do it in less than an hour. They were nice but I know that this was a one job opportunity and they took advantage of the opportunity because I didn't have a choice.  I asked a few others about this shop and one person told me that it wasn't his first choice but they were reliable. I heard Javier telling another customer about a job that will take 5 hours and will cost $900 so I thought they would charge around $180 per hour.  If you break down near them, just know it can be pricey.
P.S. After two hours, I asked Javier how much longer it would be and he said about another hour. So my boss asked me to take an Uber to work and leave the truck there.  So I told the mechanic that I needed my belongings and that is when he said it would be done in 15 minutes.

user_reviews.Description:
Went here a while back and was not impressed. The receptionist was very condescending and made me feel stupid for using basic language. I was there because my engine was overheating and I was out of town. I had already suspected it was a coolant leak and asked if I could just get a jug of tap water to cool it down temporarily so I could get home, but they said they couldn't do that and gave me some bull crap about "liability". Sure, whatever. They then said I needed to pay over $200 just to diagnose the issue. I told them it was likely a leak, but they said they still needed to do the whole diagnostic process and that it would count towards the repair. I was already annoyed, but I decided to pay it so I could get it fixed already. They then called the next day confirming a coolant leak from the radiator and quoted me $3,000 to get it replaced. I could not believe my ears. I told them I would not be paying that and to leave my car out so I could get it towed to my house.

This place is a total rip off. The ONLY thing good about this place is that they offered a courtesy Lyft ride to where I needed to go. EVERYTHING else about it was horrible. I do NOT recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Nicole
user_reviews.Description:
Very frustrating and disappointing experience. I brought my vehicle in for a check engine light after having the code read at another auto shop just an hour earlier. Despite already having the code, I was still charged an additional $155 for diagnostics, followed by nearly $400 more in recommended repairs. I clearly communicated that I had already spent a significant amount on my vehicle elsewhere and was hoping this visit would finally resolve the issue.

Less than two weeks later, the check engine light returned while I was out of town for Thanksgiving. The day after Thanksgiving, I had the engine rechecked and received a diagnostic code related to the same issue. This was extremely stressful, especially after spending so much money and during the holidays with my family.

When I called on Monday after they reopened, I explained that the check engine light was back on and shared the similar diagnostic code I had just received. I was told that since my initial repair is under warranty, they would look at the vehicle and ensure everything was fixed properly. However, a few hours later I was contacted with a new quote for an additional $500 and was told I was being done a “service” by not being charged again for diagnostics, even though I arrived with the code already provided.

Overall, the issue was not resolved despite significant cost, and I was left feeling that customer concerns came secondary to additional charges.

NOTE: When I picked up my vehicle after the initial repair, I noticed the idle was still fluctuating and brought it to their attention. I was told to “just drive it and see what happens,” rather than having the concern properly addressed. I would advise others to PROCEED WITH CAUTION when seeking service here

user_reviews.Name: SB SB
user_reviews.Description:
​I brought my vehicle to this shop for standard emissions diagnostic service due to several existing fault codes. The initial agreement was to perform a proper diagnosis. I even agreed to leave the car overnight for them to properly identify the root cause.

​Within a couple of hours, I received a call that immediately raised red flags. They claimed they couldn't figure out the issue due to "too many codes," and stated they had to clear all the codes and then drive the car around to re-generate the data. Clearing the existing fault codes is the opposite of performing a diagnosis, as it erases the crucial historical data needed to track down intermittent issues.

This rendered the diagnostic service they agreed to completely useless.
​Skeptical of the process and unwilling to leave my car overnight given the incompetence shown, I retrieved the vehicle. Upon pickup, I was immediately presented with a bill for $128.75. When I objected, asking why I was paying for a diagnosis that was explicitly not performed (they had only cleared the codes), the mechanic offered vague and unprofessional justifications. He claimed they "fixed a loose hose"—an unapproved, minor action that did nothing to address the initial codes—and then launched into demanding payment, citing the need to "pay the workers."

I offer them to perform another diagnostic review so that it may give me at least some value out of the money that I'm spending. It for something unrelated issue like the AC noise and they said that will be an extra $160.

They did not give me the keys to my car untill I had paid. Needless to say completely unprofessional, scammy and avoid this mechanic at all costs.

user_reviews.reply_text_original:
Thank you for your review, and we appreciate the opportunity to clarify our service process for you and other customers. We understand your frustration.

As part of a standard professional diagnostic for numerous active codes, clearing codes to see which ones reset is a necessary step to identify the root cause. The 18 codes you mentioned indicate multiple, potentially complex issues that require a systematic approach. A simple code read cannot diagnose that scenario.

The $128.75 charge covered the initial diagnostic time, the smoke test we performed, and the repair of the vacuum hose we identified as a leak source—a repair intended to resolve one of the active faults and move the diagnosis forward. This is a common first step in a multi-step process.

We regret that our diagnostic process and pricing did not meet your expectations. Our goal was to provide an honest, transparent assessment to address your vehicle’s significant needs in a manageable way, starting with the most pressing fault.

user_reviews.Name: Shanon Fraser
user_reviews.Description: 🙌 I happily discovered this shop by accident, as I was living in the Knox area in Dallas next to Katy Trail, and happened to see this place in its somewhat hidden location on one of my daily Katy Trail walks. And clear communication with flexible options - if you are not rich and need to pace out repairs. Rare to find in the automotive world! Highly recommend.

I am editing this review due to a more in depth diagnostic of the car DID indicate that it also needs a water pump.  They were a bit more expensive than my normal shop, but they are competent and provided the correct information. Thanks.

I bought a car at auction for my daughter because her transmission had gone out.  One the way home, it started overheating. Originally, he did not find a problem with the water pump, but a closer inspection revealed it needed to be replaced.

user_reviews.Name: Marcus Ku
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve trusted Dennis Road Automotive for many years, though it’s been a while since my last visit, mainly because they’re not open on weekends. I’ve always appreciated their straightforward service, and I still miss Riley, who brought a great personal touch to the experience.

On my most recent visit, I was charged $374 for a new battery for a Lexus ES350. I’m not sure how that compares in today’s economy, but it gave me the same feeling you get when dining out these days, quality isn’t necessarily better, yet the prices seem to jump significantly. The work was completed, and the team was professional, but the cost left me wondering if the value aligns with what it used to be.

I still want to support businesses that have served the community for so long, and I hope they continue to provide honest, dependable service at a price that feels fair in the current market.

user_reviews.Name: pondacheria scott
user_reviews.Description: Took my vehicle in December 3rd at about 9am I was told it’s going to take about 5 hours before my car get pulled back so Tyler suggested I come back at 7am on another day and my vehicle will be in and out pretty quick since I’ll be first, that’s not what happened at all. I took off work the next morning and let my children stay with me from school so I can make it there for 7am to be the first one. I told him everything that was wrong (my wheel shake when I’m going over 60 on the highway and I apply my breaks) I told him I’ll wait around since it won’t be that long. About 30 minutes later one of the mechanics come to me saying “yea we didn’t feel any shaking” I specifically said when I’m on the highway not in a neighborhood. It’s rush hour now so of course you wouldn’t be able to drive on the highway going 60+. 2 Hours pass by and no updates I walk up to the counter and ask Tyler is there an update on my vehicle he says “yes it’s your breaks I’ll call Tim soon as (another worker) get off the phone to get the approval” I took my children next door to get something to eat it’s now about 10am I get a call “we got the approval but it’s going to take a couple of hours to get the job done would you like a ride somewhere” I took the ride home. 2:19pm came I haven’t heard nothing so I called “yes he’s still working on it he’ll be done by 3pm” at 2:45pm they call and say it’s done. Went to pick it up. Instantly noticed how dirty the driver front and side of my vehicle was, got in straws and my child picture and a towel that was all neatly in my glove box laying on the floor. Drove my vehicle and it was doing the exact same thing I took it in for but with added issues. Now my driver head light mysteriously not working anymore, the maintenance required light is now on, and there’s a cloudy film that I cannot wipe off on my driver side mirror. Over $1,100 spent and a full day from work and school wasted and absolutely nothing was done but more issues and a mess to clean up. I’m very disappointed more harm than good was done. My vehicle was clean inside and out, no service lights were on, my headlights worked perfectly fine, and I could see out my side mirror great before I dropped my vehicle off here.

user_reviews.Name: sucuri999
user_reviews.Description: I took my vehicle here to initially do some routine maintenance. I will say that I was happy with the level of transparency in one sense, as they do provide very detailed photos with analytical remarks regarding the issues that require immediate attention as well as those that can be addressed at a later time. However, upon the discovery of an oil leak, I was quoted a price that was over  $2500.00 to repair. I have no doubt that not all oil leaks are created equal, but it did seem unreasonably high, even for a Euro car. I took my vehicle to another, equally well-known place a couple of miles away, and they repaired it for nearly 1/3 of the price. It’s possible that Christian brothers was trying to be overly thorough, but I also cannot help but to speculate that there may have been some padding or upselling in regards to that repair. A few hundred dollars in price difference at different locations is expected, but a $1500.00 difference for the exact same repair and, to my knowledge, fixed the exact same way with the same labor hours is curious…Everyone was very nice, though.

user_reviews.Name: Alan Zhao
user_reviews.Description:
Best Choice Auto & Body truly lives up to their name.

I came in with a strange and inconsistent clicking and bumping sound sometimes when the car accelerated. This started right after a maintenance service at a Honda dealership, where I had an oil change, tire rotation, and brake fluid flush. When I returned to the dealership the next day, a technician acknowledged that he heard the sound but claimed the issue wasn’t related to anything they had done.

Over time, the problem got worse.

Wayne at Best Choice took the time to thoroughly inspect the suspension and finally diagnosed the issue: all the wheel lugs were loose. I strongly believe this was caused by the tire rotation done during the dealer's service. Once Wayne fixed the problem, the strange noise disappeared completely.

If left unchecked, this could have become a very dangerous situation—a loose tire can easily lead to a serious accident. They didn’t just fix my car—they may have saved my life.

You can tell this team genuinely cares about their work and their customers. On behalf of my family, I want to extend a heartfelt thank you to Wayne and the entire team at Best Choice Auto & Body.

user_reviews.Name: Tracy Civick
user_reviews.Description:
I took my 2022 Dodge Ram in December 2024 after backing into a light-post in a parking lot. The bumper needed replacement. I researched online and selected a few body shops to give me quotes based on reviews. The quotes were similar but Catherine was able to see my vehicle right away.

Upon my visit, there was the exact same model truck with front end damage. They were able to replace my bumper with that vehicle lower than the quoted price and the workmanship was excellent, plus it was done within 24 hours (photos attached). This saved me a days worth of car rental. On top of that they gave me a ride to the car rental place.

Due to this positive experience I returned a few weeks later to see if they could look at my spouse's Volvo. The dealership quoted us over $1K to fix a dent in the rear hatch. I asked if they could pop it out, and they quoted me $200 as it would take a few hours (basically for labor). I said to move forward and waited in the lobby area. 15 minutes later they came back with the dent fixed letting me know they didn't have to remove the frame as expected. Then they told me this was free of charge!

Incredible service, honesty, and great work. This spot is a gem and they've earned a loyal customer.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I’m leaving Compean Autos in Dallas and I can honestly say they did an outstanding job. I was extremely impressed with the quality of their work and, just as important, how flexible and helpful they were throughout the entire process.
A big thank you to Catherine and Victor, who were both amazing to work with. They were professional, communicative, and truly went above and beyond to make sure everything was handled correctly. They even helped me with my warranty claims, which made the process smooth and stress-free.
The polish and buff they did on my truck was incredible — the truck looks beautiful, smooth, and extremely glossy. I had previously taken my truck to another shop, Texas Collision, and while the paint job looked okay at first, I later noticed overspray on the rear passenger side, specifically above the back fender near the rear tire and on the right side of the rear windshield. When I mentioned the wait, the response was simply that no one had informed him. The tone of the interaction felt dismissive rather than service-oriented.

Additionally, while I was carrying two child car seats, he walked ahead of me and made only a minimal effort to hold the door. It may seem like a small detail, but it reflects the overall lack of attentiveness during the visit.

For a dealership that promotes a premium customer experience, I expected significantly better communication, professionalism, and basic courtesy. Unfortunately, this visit did not meet that standard.

user_reviews.Name: Will Flei
user_reviews.Description:
I can’t say enough good things about Mr. Glass in Dallas.

From the moment I walked in, the entire team was friendly, professional, and genuinely helpful. They even had a small desk in the waiting area, which let me sit and work comfortably while they took care of my car — a small detail, but it made a big difference.

I had a windshield replacement on my Mercedes, and I was very specific about wanting OEM glass, not aftermarket. Mr. Glass handled everything professionally, worked through the approval process, and explained the options clearly. I did end up paying a little over the alternative option, but it was well worth it. The OEM glass is noticeably better, and I’m very glad I stuck to my guns.

The install itself was clean, precise, and done right, including proper calibration. The final cost was significantly less than the Mercedes dealer, with no shortcuts taken.

Great people, great communication, excellent workmanship. If you care about your vehicle and want the job done correctly the first time, this is the place to go. I would absolutely use them again and recommend them without hesitation.

user_reviews.Name: Cowboy
user_reviews.Description:
Jorge was fantastic from the very first contact. I sent an inquiry at 2:30 AM the night before, and he was able to come out to my residence by 10 AM on a Saturday. His responsiveness alone was impressive.
He did an excellent job cleaning the interior of my truck after an accident and a spill had left it much dirtier than normal. In addition to restoring the interior, he also cleaned the entire exterior of the truck, applied a ceramic coating, and even performed an ozone treatment inside to eliminate any lingering smells or odors.
He thoroughly cleaned every panel of the truck, including under the seats and hard-to-reach areas, and overall did a fantastic job especially considering the time crunch.
On top of that, he was the most affordable option out of the many detailing services I contacted in the area. Most of the others didn’t even get back to me, especially given the unexpected emergency and timing of the situation.
If anything ever happens to my vehicles again, I would absolutely use his services and recommend him to anyone—especially in an emergency situation. He completed the job efficiently and was even able to work on the truck without me needing to be present.
10/10 — highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Nathan
user_reviews.Description:
I have to give two stars. Here’s why:

At first glance, everything looked great, so much so that I even offered to refer them to others. But once the interior dried, I saw the real results.

When they shampooed and conditioned my seats, they didn’t use a wet-vac to extract the moisture. Because of that, I now have more stains on my seats than I did before the wash.

I paid over $200 for the car to be soaked with chemicals and left to air dry. I also paid $75 dollars for a biohazard fee becuase of toddler urine accident in the back seat. I’ll pay a premium, but I expect premium results.

My dash and interior had visible residue and streaks. Even my windows somehow were messy after I finally got in the car and started driving.

Some areas were still completely wet, and I had to finish drying it myself. There were also missed spots that I was shocked to see were not hit on the seats.

Again, when you get a detail, everything is fresh, so you give the head nod, you say hey appreciate it and keep it moving becuase it looks good in the moment.

Had the stains been there before my service, I wouldn’t even waste my time writing this. It essentially felt like this was something I could’ve done myself.

I held off writing this to give it a chance to dry out fully, hoping I wouldn’t need to leave a negative review. They were polite and worked hard in the heat. The customer service is there when you call but the output needs to match.

Ultimately, The results didn’t match the price, and definitely didn’t earn the referrals I was ready to give them. Disappointing. *Pictures are after the chemicals have dried*

user_reviews.Name: Jameson Mantzel
user_reviews.Description: My girlfriend (2016 Toyota Camry) got into a minor fender-bender which ruined her right fender and busted her bumper bracket and bumper. We shopped for estimates all around the north side of Dallas and settled on Wilson at Dallas Detailing and Buffing. Not only did he give us the best price for fixing the damage (80% of the next highest bid and less than half of the highest bid), but his service was second to none. He walked us through the process to understand exactly what it is we wanted to do and where each dollar was spent. We opted to get aftermarket parts to save on cost, replacing and repainting the fender, replacing and repainting the bumper, and replacing the bracket as well as blending the door with the fender. Communication during the process was excellent, Wilson kept me updated at every stage until it was ready. When we got the car back it looked brand new! Lowest price, excellent workmanship, and a trustworthy individual to do business with. If I’m ever in need of body repair, they’ll be my first call!

I recently had my car detailed and I couldn’t be more impressed with the results. From start to finish, the service was professional, thorough, and well worth the investment.
The exterior looks better than when I first bought the car. The paint has a deep, glossy shine, and they did an incredible job removing swirl marks and minor scratches. Even the wheels and tires were spotless and perfectly dressed.

If you’re looking for high-quality car detailing with excellent customer service, I highly recommend them. I’ll definitely be coming back!

user_reviews.Name: Maegan L
user_reviews.Description:
Chris seemed like a very nice and genuine guy. However, I think his business practices are a little scammy. I found his number on Google and called to get a quote for an interior cleaning for my Kia Soul with dog hair. Chris said he charges $150 and that dog hair was included. He said he could come out immediately to take a look. As soon as he arrived, he began taking things out of his van and started cleaning. Halfway through vacuuming I asked how much it would be now that he's seen the car, he stuck with $150, stating that he usually charges for dog hair, but he's got me covered this time, even though he said the cost already covers dog hair on the phone. I found his website, where it says a "Basic Full Wash" is $140, which includes basic interior cleaning and an exterior wash. I paid $150 for just a very basic interior cleaning. Chris was done cleaning in literally less than 45 minutes. No other car cleaning or detailing company I've looked at can complete a semi-thorough cleaning under an hour. After inspecting my car, there's still dog hair in the backseat that wasn't vacuumed up. He didn't bother to wipe down the underside of my steering wheel area. The brake and gas pedal weren't touched, and there was stuff left unvaccumed behind them.  Additionally, the cleaner/conditioner he used on all the plastic in my car is very greasy and has made everything slick. I appreciate his friendliness, but not his cleanliness. Look elsewhere if you're wanting more
than a mediocre job.

Response to owner: The price isn't the issue, it's the quality of work. I have no problem paying for a job well done. However, charging $150 for there to still be a significant amount of dog hair, dirt, and untouched spots in my car is ridiculous. You call yourself "the best", but I could've done a better job with my own vacuum and rags. Do better.

user_reviews.Description:
Chantz at Martin Auto Detailing is exceptional! I've had him handle paint correction, PPF, and ceramic coating on multiple vehicles now, and the quality is consistently outstanding.

user_reviews.Description:
Chantz is by far THE best ceramic coater and auto detailing service professional in the DFW metroplex.

My high level of OCD demands the highest level of perfection, which is usually quite difficult to meet. Especially with a black on black vehicle, but Chantz’s incredible attention to detail left me speechless.

I took my brand new truck to him to be ceramic coated and he returned it to me FAR better than when it rolled off the factory production line, not a single swirl mark was left to be seen.

He’s incredibly communicative, friendly, and the level of customer service far surpasses any other provider you’ll ever meet as he goes above and beyond. He has a passion for what he does, which is exactly what you want when trusting someone to enhance or even just maintain the appearance of your vehicle.

user_reviews.Name: Danny D
user_reviews.Description:
Fantastic experience! I googled where to get emissions testing, and Quix was one of the first hits. I picked at random. I will ABSOLUTELY go back here, including for other future car needs!

The boss dude and all of the staff were efficient and friendly, and no one made me feel bad about my old beater car or the fact I had no idea what I was doing. It was in & out in minutes, AND they did multiple other emissions tests for other clients right before and after me without any delays.

And, the main guy went above and beyond by giving me a printout of the Dallas county tax assessor locations, without me even asking!

A++ for efficiency/timeliness, friendliness, competence, and integrity (they offered to meet a few other obvious needs, like my busted wipers, but made it clear it was not required for this test)
